display_provenance.others: Blair-chart mouth patches drawn in the character's own line/colour style, colours sampled from the canon face; mouth shapes only, no likeness change
display_provenance.rest: the character's own mouth as drawn in the canon art — never redrawn

driver: Rhubarb 1.13.0 (~/opt/bin/rhubarb) TSV/JSON mouth cues -> stepped display timeline on the mouth slot; body held per Hanna-Barbera dialogue method
note: Shared by Mochiko / Hex / Aeon. Per-character copies live in each character folder; character copies carry the measured mouth anchor (image px) once the canon art is inspected. See TALKING-SEAT-SPEC.md for the full spec.
overrides: W/Q phoneme onset on an F segment keys W_Q for the first ~80 ms, then U
segments shorter than 40 ms are dropped; previous shape held
shape changes land on even frames at 24 fps (on 2s) unless a plosive (Rhubarb A) forces an odd frame
symbol_type: Graphic (frame-accurate stepped display swap, no blending)
